Well, 73.9% of them said that grading policies was the most important information students seek most in faculty review groups followed by teaching style and teaching behavior and friendliness which were 52.2% individually and then the work on assignment which was 30.4%. The next question I wanted to measure that to what extent the negative reviews, to what extent the student feels nervous and stressed out after hearing a native reviews. So 65.2% of the students say that they agree or strongly agree. We agree to the fact that they feel more nervous and stressed out when they hear native reviews and the rest of them were neutral and they disagreed. And the most important and the most surprising factor that I asked my respondents that did the overall classroom experience matched with expectations set by the Facebook faculty review groups. So yeah, thank you everyone.
